states.name: Marie Antoinette
states.title: White Lily of the Guillotine
states.description: She was once a compassionate young queen, who loved her country and her people. Antoinette sought to combat the widespread hunger among her subjects. But her pure intentions were drowned by the greedy machinations of the nobility, and eventually, her own people came to condemn the queen as a traitor. Having been abandoned by both her kingdom and her people, she had stopped believing in anyone at all.

states.name: Marie Antoinette
states.title: White Lily of the Guillotine
states.description:
Whenever Antoinette discovers a good bakery on her travels, she always makes a point of stopping by. Asked why, she merely laughs and changes the subject.
Back when she was queen, she once shared a loaf of freshly baked bread with her faithful young servant while they strolled through the capital of her kingdom. The taste of the bread they ate together that day has been etched into her memory, and even now, she can remember it like yesterday.

states.name: Marie Antoinette
states.title: White Lily of the Guillotine
states.description:
"I would rather trust no one than be betrayed."

Yet while wandering in a desert at the edge of the known world, she encountered a knight so devoted to keeping her oaths to the point of foolishness. As Antoinette observed this knight, something inside of her heart that she long had assumed to have died came back to life, ever so faintly.
